description: Trajectory analysis module - track graduated tokens over time, calculate velocity/acceleration, determine trajectory phase, compute continuation probability, and integrate into alerts and main loop.
steps: Create memescanner/trajectory.py with TrajectoryAnalyzer class implementing velocity, acceleration, phase detection, and continuation probability
Update database.py to add token_snapshots table with all required fields
Update probability.py to use trajectory data for tokens above 200k MC
Update telegram_bot.py to include trajectory info in alerts
Update main.py to integrate trajectory analysis into scan loop
acceptance_criteria: TrajectoryAnalyzer calculates mc_velocity, mc_acceleration, volume_velocity, holder_velocity
Phase detection correctly identifies LAUNCHING, PUMPING, PEAKING, DUMPING, DEAD
assess_continuation returns all required fields including continuation_probability, projected MCs, recommendation
Continuation probability formula uses all specified factors (velocity, acceleration, volume, buy_sell, liquidity, age, distance_from_high)
Database has token_snapshots table with all required columns
Probability calculator uses trajectory for tokens above 200k MC and shows relative targets (2x, 5x, 10x)
Telegram alert includes trajectory phase, velocity, acceleration, P(2x), P(5x), time since graduation, volume trend
Main loop takes snapshots for graduated tokens and suppresses DUMPING/DEAD alerts
HIGH PRIORITY marking for LAUNCHING phase with score > 50
